title: CHAPTER 12: RECENT HR TRENDS AND DEVELOPMENTS

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Digital HR integrates automation, cloud systems, and HR analytics to streamline workforce management.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) forms a critical strategic pillar for modern workforce culture.
Emerging HR concepts address agile workflows, remote/hybrid operational models, and employee well-being.

cells: Technology
Application in HR
Banking Adoption
HRMS / SAP / Workday / PeopleSoft
Integrated HR management system; payroll, leave, performance, recruitment on single platform
SBI, HDFC, Axis use SAP; private banks on Workday; RRBs often use simpler systems
AI and Machine Learning in HR
Resume screening; predictive analytics for attrition; chatbots for HR queries; automated scheduling
HDFC, ICICI use AI chatbots for HR helpdesk; attrition prediction models; digital onboarding
Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
Manages recruitment workflow; tracks applications; integration with job portals
IBPS uses ATS for banking exams at scale; private banks use Taleo, Greenhouse
Learning Management System (LMS)
Online training delivery; track completion; assessment; certification
Banks have LMS for compliance training (KYC, AML, POSH); IIBF courses online
People Analytics / HR Analytics
Data-driven HR decisions; dashboards; predictive modelling; workforce planning
Attrition hotspot identification; branch staffing optimisation; productivity analysis
Digital Onboarding
Paperless joining; e-signature; virtual orientation; pre-boarding apps
Accelerated by COVID-19; standard in private banks; SBI implemented digital onboarding
Performance Management Tech
Continuous feedback tools; OKR platforms; real-time recognition; goal tracking
Replacing annual reviews with continuous PM; pulse surveys; Betterworks, Lattice

rows: Bringing diverse perspectives into the organization
Fairness in processes, resources, and opportunities
Culture of belonging and active participation
Ensuring every employee feels valued and heard

cells: Dimension
Details
Banking Initiatives
Gender Diversity
Women representation in banking workforce and leadership; glass ceiling; gender pay gap
FICCI-FLO Banking Committee; SBI Women Leadership Programme; HDFC gender parity target; RBI women employees: ~20% of workforce
Persons with Disabilities (PwD)
3% reservation in government jobs; accessibility; reasonable accommodation
PSBs follow 3% PwD reservation; accessibility in branch premises; assistive technology
SC/ST and OBC Reservation
Reservation policy in government banks; 15% SC + 7.5% ST + 27% OBC in PSBs
Roster system; liaison officer; annual report to Govt on reservation compliance
Generational Diversity
Managing Gen Z, Millennials, Gen X, Baby Boomers together; different values and work styles
Reverse mentoring; flexible policies; digital-native workforce integration in banking
LGBTQ+ Inclusion
Post Navtej Singh Johar judgment (2018) :non-discrimination; inclusive policies
Private banks (HDFC, Kotak) have LGBTQ+ ERGs; pride month recognition; policy updates

items: Understand the structural differences between Diversity (representation), Equity (fairness), and Inclusion (belonging).
Focus on the role of HR technology, People Analytics, and AI tools in contemporary human resource decision-making.
Be prepared for questions on new-age workforce models including the Gig Economy and Hybrid Work environments.

cells: Concept
Description
Employee Experience (EX)
Holistic view of employee's journey; culture, technology, workspace; moves beyond engagement to overall experience; Jacob Morgan framework
Gig Economy / Workforce
Freelancers, contract workers, platform workers; flexible; non-permanent; covered under new Social Security Code 2020 in India
Remote Work / Hybrid Work
Post-COVID norm; challenges: monitoring, culture, collaboration; RBI guidelines on work from home for banks
Psychological Safety
Amy Edmondson: team environment where members feel safe to take risks, speak up, make mistakes without fear; essential for innovation and learning
OKRs (Objectives and Key Results)
Goal-setting framework; ambitious objectives + measurable key results; quarterly cycles; Intel, Google, Banks adopting
Talent Marketplace
Internal mobility platform; employees can apply for projects, roles within organisation; democratises opportunity; reduces attrition
People-First Leadership
Leader prioritises employee well-being and growth; servant leadership; mental health awareness; financial wellness
Total Talent Management
Manage permanent employees + contractors + gig workers + alumni as unified talent pool
ESG in HR (Social Dimension)
Environmental, Social, Governance framework; HR's role in social metrics: diversity, labour practices, employee development, human rights
